findings.problem: The prompt-builder takes role: UserRole but the design never states the one-line binding that the dashboard page derives role from persona.role (verified personas.Persona.role is UserRole, so it lines up).
findings.fix: In §B Call shape, add: the page computes buildDashboardPrompt({ role: persona.role, selectedProjectKeys: selected }) where persona.role is the UserRole from personas.ts and selected is the PM checkbox state (empty for dev/exec).

findings.location: design §B Prompt-builder behavior + Project selection UI
findings.problem: The builder defensively ignores selectedProjectKeys for dev/exec and there is a test for it, but the design does not state that the page passes no keys for non-PM personas nor that selection resets on persona change.
findings.fix: In §B Project selection UI add: selection state resets when persona changes (useState default []), and for Developer/Executive the page passes no keys, so the builder's ignore-keys branch is belt-and-braces.

findings.problem: ServiceInfo adds free-form description strings not traceable to any source, and the connections test asserts only key/length, so a typo in label/description ships silently.
findings.fix: Optionally extend connections.test.ts to assert each service has a non-empty label and description (SERVICES.forEach(s => { expect(s.label).toBeTruthy(); expect(s.description).toBeTruthy(); })) without a DOM.
